proceedings.outcome: the applicant was arrested and remanded in custody
proceedings.supporting_quote: Following the murder of V.T. on July 10, 2005, the applicant was arrested and remanded in custody on July 27, 2005.

proceedings.outcome: convicted the applicant of aggravated murder and the illegal acquisition, possession, and carrying of firearms, sentencing him to 17 years’ imprisonment
proceedings.supporting_quote: On December 8, 2006, the court convicted the applicant of aggravated murder and the illegal acquisition, possession, and carrying of firearms, sentencing him to 17 years’ imprisonment.
On June 27, 2007, the Tbilisi Court of Appeal upheld the conviction, finding no evidence that pressure had been applied to the witnesses.

proceedings.outcome: declared the applicant's appeal on points of law inadmissible
proceedings.supporting_quote: On February 20, 2008, the Supreme Court declared the applicant's appeal on points of law inadmissible.

proceedings.outcome: convicted [M.T.] and given partially suspended sentences
proceedings.supporting_quote: On December 26, 2006 (M.T.) and January 23, 2007 (Z.T.), both were convicted at first instance and given partially suspended sentences.

proceedings.outcome: convicted [Z.T.] and given partially suspended sentences
proceedings.supporting_quote: On December 26, 2006 (M.T.) and January 23, 2007 (Z.T.), both were convicted at first instance and given partially suspended sentences.

Following the applicant's complaint to the Chief Prosecutor in August 2010—alleging he had been beaten by the governor of Rustavi Prison no. 6 and pressured to withdraw his application to the European Court of Human Rights—an investigation was opened on August 31, 2010.
